title: US-short §8 强赛道试探名额 (theme_probe) + theme_opportunity_state vocab + seat matrix governance — const-pins the user-approved (2026-06-22) 4-state vocab, the §4.5 dynamic selection-seat map (#29), the §8 theme_probe seat matrix (#27), the hard-zero precedence, the theme_probe invariants, and the defensive-entry pullback-only + single-breakout-exception rule
description: Batch-2 declarative governance contract (user-approved design proposal docs/us_short_theme_opportunity_state_seat_design_20260622.md). Freezes: the monotonic theme_opportunity_state vocab {no_strong_theme<normal<strong<extreme} serving BOTH §4.5 selection seats (#29: 12+3 / 10+5 / 8+7) and §8 theme_probe (#27); the regime×state theme_probe seat matrix (极度防御 row=0, 防御+strong/extreme=1, 进攻+extreme=2 are design-given; 震荡=1 / 进攻+strong=1 are v1 priors); hard-zero conditions (极度防御/cooldown/hard_veto) that override the matrix and the breakout exception; the theme_probe invariants (forced min size + high confidence, all §8 caps stack, cost-floor applies, bypasses risk-budget amplification); and the defensive-entry rule (pullback-only, the extreme+no-gap+in-band single breakout exception). The vocab is intentionally NOT in the action_table contract enum yet. draft-07 cannot express: seat-matrix design-given cells == §8, monotonic strength order, calibration #27/#29 ∈ the lifecycle registry, cost_floor_observe_reason ∈ observe_reason_types, provenance in §4.5/§8 — enforced in tests.

theme_opportunity_state_vocab.description: §7/§8 theme_opportunity_state 4-state vocab, monotonic strength (no_strong_theme<normal<strong<extreme). User-approved Q1. Order is the strength order.

vocab_is_monotonic_strength.description: Vocab order encodes monotonically increasing theme opportunity (so '≥ strong' gates are well-defined).

selection_seat_map.description: §4.5 dynamic selection-seat split per state (#29, line 163): 无强赛道 12+3 / 常 10+5 / 强赛道 8+7; extreme shares strong's 8+7 (both 强赛道周).

theme_probe_seat_matrix.description: §8 theme_probe seat upper bound per (regime × state) (#27). 极度防御 row=0 / 防御+strong·extreme=1 / 进攻+extreme=2 are design-given (line 221); 震荡=1 and 进攻+strong=1 are v1 conservative priors (Q2-approved). no_strong_theme/normal columns=0 (probe only with a confirmed strong theme).

hard_zero_conditions.description: §8 条件 that force 0 probe seats regardless of the matrix AND override the defensive breakout exception. `symbol_cooldown_active` = 单票再入场冷静期; `portfolio_guard_cooldown` = 组合熔断 portfolio_guard_status=cooldown (禁新建/加仓, line 230) — a theme_probe is a NEW entry so BOTH cooldowns block it; plus 极度防御 regime + hard_veto (line 222 不放行).

portfolio_guard_blocking_status.description: The portfolio_guard_status whose effects block a new entry / add (== the `cooldown` state in us_short_portfolio_guard_governance, block_new_entry=true / block_add=true). A theme_probe is a new entry, so this state hard-zeros it.

section8_caps_that_stack.description: §8 line 222 — the probe bypasses risk-budget amplification but STILL stacks under ALL of these caps.

risk_tag.description: §8 line 222 — the probe row carries this risk_tag.

cost_floor_observe_reason.description: §8 line 224 — a cost-inefficient probe observes with this (frozen §9 observe_reason_type).

seat_calibration_item_id.description: §8 theme_probe seat counts/caps + cost-floor safety multiple = prior → §13.1 #27.
